lia: bringing up Orphean-9B (int4) — initial smoke looked fine, but after ~150 tokens generations start to drift vs fp16 baseline. suspect a staggered/head-stagger rotary packing + a vocab shadow in the export.

anna: can you dump tokenizer ids and a snippet of token stream near the drift? sentinel/BOS sometimes end up in high slots with some exports.

sam: same symptom we've hit before: steady for ~128 then phase/offset creep. usually head-order / packing or qkv grouping. :thinking_face:

lia: minimal repro attached — run fp16 then int4 and compare logits/topk at step 160.

```python
prompt = 'Data pipelines told a different story...'
toks = tok.encode(prompt)
print('tail tokens', toks[-20:])
# run fp16 -> save logits@160
# run int4 -> compare topk@160
```

kevin: check model.json for rotary/export fields: `rotary_layout`, `rotary_pack`, `rotary_dim`, and any `vocab_map` hints.

lia: model.json shows: "rotary_pack": "staggered", "rotary_dim": 64, "n_heads": 16. Also vendor included `vocab_shadow: true` in meta. loader currently assumes contiguous heads and identity vocab mapping.

anna: if rotary is staggered (e.g., head_map = [0,4,8,12,1,5,9,13,...]) and we interpret as contiguous it will mis-index KV cache and cause delayed drift. likewise vocab_shadow means token ids were remapped with a high-slot overlay.

sam: run `orch-tools inspect --rotary-map orphean.bin` — it prints the head_map and any shadow table. lia, can you run?

lia: ran inspector. outputs: `head_map: [0,4,8,12,1,5,9,13,2,6,10,14,3,7,11,15]` and `vocab_shadow_table: {50256: 30522, 50257: 30523}` (two sentinel ids moved into top 50256/7). our tokenizer maps the other way.

kevin: that staggered interleave explains the ~quarter-head delayed drift — cache expects sequence in canonical ordering. the vocab shadow explains occasional mismatched tokens in generation.

ci-bot: CI: orphean-int4-smoke failed, ppl delta +0.23 at 02:11:07. Full run: https://ci.internal/runs/2639

lia: proposed plan: 1) implement load-time head remap using inspector head_map; 2) apply vocab_shadow reverse map at tokenization boundary (transparent to callers); 3) compute checksum/signature after reshaping weights; 4) add unit tests: (a) top-1 equality for first 180 tokens between fp16 and remapped int4, (b) generation ngram overlap on our helpfulness mini-set. ETA EOD.

anna: add auto-detection: if model.json declares `rotary_pack: staggered` or inspector returns known patterns we auto-apply remap and emit telemetry (vendor+model id) so we can follow up. for vocab_shadow, prefer applying a lightweight shadow-reverse map at loader tokenizers so downstream code sees canonical ids.

sam: also add a runtime sanity assert: after remap compute small warmup activations and assert L2 diff < 1e-3 vs fp16 for first 8 tokens; if assertion fails, fail load and surface error to support. avoids silent corruption.

kevin: watch for qkv grouping differences too (some exports interleave q,k,v per head). when reshaping, validate shapes and add a small elementwise sample check to ensure q/k ordering correct. log mismatch to vendor telemetry.

lia: will implement remap + vocab reverse mapping, add tests, and push a PR with inspector command, patch snippet, and CI link. will include rollback flag `--disable-automatic-remap` for emergency.

anna: :thumbsup: good plan. once merged run full smoke + helpfulness evals and if green we should backport to dedicated runtimes. also open vendor bug ticket with the export team recommending canonical head-major + no vocab shadow.

sam: adding regression job: nightly helpfulness ngram overlap for newly onboarded models so we catch quality delta even when ppl matches.

lia: posting PR WIP in #pr-reviews shortly. ping me here if CI still shows drift after patch. thanks all. :rocket:
